title: One room, one picture
rule: The whole incident in a single panel: the agent appears several times along his path through one continuous office.
declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome
made: one print: the 99-ways-template clerk-removed Rothstein set plate (editor/set.plate.r1.png, cupboard opened) whole, mounted with a white print border and four black paper photo corners on the LoC 1934 sheet

the agent laid four times with the 99-ways-template FK rig (build_page.lay_clerk), each with its own pose: seated behind the desk with the memo (E0); at the ticket window, mirrored to turn toward the glass, head turned to the pane, forearm lowered (E1); under the clock, head tipped back on the collar hinge toward it, pencil at his temple (E2); in the open cupboard right of the swung leaf, mirrored to face the key on the leaf, pencil at his chin by the FK solve (E4-E5)

occlusion by real plate objects only: each standing figure is laid so his shirt's lower edge falls just below the counter top and the plate's counter is re-laid over that strip only within the figure's own footprint (no rectangle, so the open leaf is untouched); his own left forearm and fist and his pencil forearm stay in front, resting on the counter, so the counter edge never runs across a whole figure; E0 is occluded the same way by the desk
the Bubley 1943 figure behind the glass (clipped to the pane, 30% of the pane's own pixels laid back over her): at the glass for both her lines
the Rothstein clock case and its own hands re-set to 4:10; the cupboard door on its jamb with hook, ANRC key and SERVICE tag (build_page.lay_door_key); the SERVICE card on the closed right-hand door
a dotted pencil track with arrowheads joining his appearances (handmade)
four cut-paper balloons lettered with the canon lines in the shared pen hand, pasted over the print's top and bottom edges in reading order; caption and folio in the pen hand

events.E0: agent behind the desk, memo slip on it (centre foreground)
events.E1: agent at the ticket window, turned toward the glass; stranger behind it; question balloon (top left) tailed from the upper right to her mouth's right corner
events.E2: agent under the wall clock (4:10), head tipped back toward it, pencil at his temple; answer balloon (top centre) tailed to his mouth's right
events.E3: thanks balloon (left, below) tailed from below-left to her mouth's left corner; her face left clear
events.E4: cupboard open, key on its hook with its SERVICE tag
events.E5: agent before the open cupboard, pencil to chin, forgetting balloon (bottom right); SERVICE door shut

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

beat: on one unchanging print the agent is laid down again and again along a dotted track: desk, window, clock, then the cupboard is opened and he stands before it
beat_frames: b01: the empty office on the print (cupboard shut, clock at 4:10, SERVICE card)
b02: + the agent at the desk with the memo (E0)
b03: + the agent at the ticket window, the stranger behind the glass, her question; first leg of the track (E1)
b04: + the agent under the clock, his answer; second leg (E2)
b06: the cupboard opened, the key on its hook; third leg (E4)
b07: + the agent at the open cupboard, pencil to chin, the forgetting line (E5) = the page

self_check.occlusion: counter/desk re-laid only inside each figure's footprint; fist and pencil forearm kept in front
self_check.check: A reader finds the agent more than once in one frame and orders his appearances E0 to E5 (maker's judgement from the full-size page; blind reading pending)
self_check.evidence: measured (size, bytes, appearance count) and perceptually judged (from frames) by the maker

weaknesses: the agent source is one frontal, downcast Rothstein photograph: the FK rig can mirror, turn the head in the picture plane and move the pencil forearm, but cannot give a true profile (E1) or raise his eyes (E2: the head tips back, the eyelids stay down)
the three standing appearances still share one torso cut-out, scaled alike behind the same counter
